messages:
Priya: FYI — HarborX postmortem is done. We still have open follow-ups around VPC peering flaps and on-prem isolation regressions. Can we assign owners and dates? Thanks.
Jon: I can take VPC peering remediation. Need help narrowing which peering configs triggered the flap.
Megan: I'll own onprem constraints (storage mount timeouts + firewall rule race). ETA end of sprint? :calendar: 
Carlos: +1 on ownership. For VPC I can run diff of peering routes and share a short checklist by EOD.
Priya: Perfect — Jon (VPC), Megan (Onprem), Carlos (QA checklist). Can we list direct action items here with owners + target dates.
Jon: Action: reproduce peering flap in staging (tag: harb-regen). Steps: run `peering-sim --latency 200ms --conn=250` then tail logs `kubectl logs -l app=peering-controller`. Owner: Jon. Target: 2024-11-10.
Megan: Action: add retry/backoff on mount + add firewall acceptance tests. Owner: Megan. Target: 2024-11-17. Note: onprem vendor has a weekly maintenance window Wed mornings.
Carlos: Action: QA harness that replays traffic and validates prefix isolation; add regression alert. Owner: Carlos. Target: 2024-11-14.
Priya: Cross-cutting: update runbook with rollback play (who calls, who peeks at KV cache). Owner: Priya. Target: 2024-11-12.
remediation-bot: Created ticket INF-4872, INF-4873, INF-4874 assigned to Jon, Megan, Carlos respectively.
Megan: Quick ask — do we standardize peering MTU checks? We saw mismatch in logs.
Jon: Yes, add MTU check to preflight. I'll add to my checklist. 
Priya: Recurring pattern note: peering flaps often correlate with batchs of long-lived KV cache updates during backups. Add monitoring metric for KV update latency spike. Owner: infra-monitoring (unassigned) — Carlos can spin a dashboard.
Carlos: I'll create dashboard and an alert on 95th pct KV update > 500ms. Target: 2024-11-09.
Jon: Dependencies: need staging with identical VPC AS path — ops help needed. @ops Can we get a mirrored staging peering by next Tue?
Megan: ops ping as well for firewall test ips.
Priya: OK — owners + dates set. We'll review progress in Wed infra sync. If anything slips, flag here. :thumbsup: 
Carlos: A couple follow-ups after QA: add automated sweep that checks for stale peering entries every 24h. Owner: Carlos. Target: 2024-11-20.
remediation-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly check-in on Thursdays at 10:00 starting 2024-11-02.
Priya: thanks all. I'll post a short summary into the postmortem doc and link the tickets. Closing thread unless blockers.
